title: Delete abandoned auto-drafts

older_than_days.description: Only auto-drafts untouched for at least this many days.

description: Removes auto-drafts that were never written. WordPress creates one every time somebody opens the editor and abandons it; it deletes them itself after seven days, but only for posts it created, and only when its own scheduled task runs.
breaks: An abandoned draft nobody returned to is gone for good
